75185.Description: Decima slams an orb of arcane flux into the ground, causing a cascade of ruptures to form around her. The ground heaves with enough force to shatter bones and cripple her enemies.

$values.Description: Damage and condition damage taken are increased; stacks intensity.

75191.Name: Thrumming Presence
75191.Description:
Decima's aura makes your bones resonate with arcane flux. Each time she gains charge, the sensation becomes more painful.

Makes enemies more vulnerable to Decima's fluxlance beams.

75195.Name: Rake the Rot
75195.Description: Greer sweeps his claw in a 60-degree cone, damaging, crippling, poisoning, and knocking back targets. This attack sets up Stomp the Mould, the final attack in the chain.

75197.Name: Earthrend
75197.Description: When Decima leaps, anything she lands on gets squashed like a bug.

75200.Name: Eruption Vent
75200.Description: Ura causes a sulfuric geyser to erupt at target's location after several seconds, creating a shockwave and leaving behind a geyser that inflicts poison and Sulfuric Acid on enemies and benefits allies.

75205.Name: Fulminate
75205.Description: Conduits that already have 3 charges when hit by fluxlance or thunder attack damage all enemies in the encounter, apply exposed, and grant Decima 5 stacks of Peal of Harmony and Peal of Discord.

$values.Description: Decima will periodically consumes stacks of this effect to target a number of conduits with Chorus of Thunder.
Decima will periodically consume stacks of this effect to target a number of nearby enemies with Chorus of Thunder.

75210.Name: Sweep the Mold
75210.Description: The Greerling sweeps its claw in a 60-degree cone, damaging, bleeding, poisoning, and knocking back targets. This attack sets up Rake the Rot, the next attack in the chain.

75221.Name: Fulgent Aura
75221.Description: Charged conduits emit a dangerous aura of Arcane Flux that damages nearby enemies. The aura increases in size as the conduit gains more Charge.

75231.Name: Foreshock
75231.Description: Decima performs a series of stomp attacks to pulverize her puny opponents.

75248.Name: Stomp the Growth
75248.Description: Greer stomps 3 times in quick succession. The first two stomps hit all targets in a circle around the impact point, dealing damage, inflicting poison, and applying vulnerability. The third stomp creates a wave of corruption.

75249.Name: Discordant Thunder
75249.Description:
Decima calls out to the storm, and the storm responds with a thundering chorus.

A number of players closest to Decima are targeted with bolts of Discordant Thunder. If a bolt's area of effect strikes a conduit, it gains some charge.

$values.Description: Decima will periodically consume stacks of this effect to target a number of nearby enemies with Chorus of Thunder.

75251.Name: Rot Eruption
75251.Description: Rot walls burst up from the ground, knocking players back and creating a noxious blight at the eruption point. Players hit by a rot eruption take damage and gain poison, bleeding, and a stack of infectious rot.

75258.Name: Pressure Blast
75258.Description: Causes an eruption that imprisons the target and nearby enemies. Can be dispelled using a bloodstone shard.

75262.Name: Scattering Sporeblast
75262.Description: The Greerling rapidly fires exploding spores in a cone in front of it. Players in this cone will be directly targeted by the spores.

75270.Name: Sparking Aura
75270.Description: Conduits with charge periodically release dancing sparks that move toward Decima. Sparks lose some health and stop moving temporarily when enough players are standing in their aura. If the dancing spark reaches Decima, it is absorbed and grants her some charge.

75277.Name: Earthrend
75277.Description: When Decima leaps, anything she lands on gets squashed like a bug.

75286.Name: Rake the Rot
75286.Description: The Greerling sweeps its claw in a 60-degree cone, damaging, crippling, poisoning, and knocking back targets. This attack sets up Stomp the Mould, the final attack in the chain.

75287.Name: Rot the World
75287.Description: Greer rains explosive spores down on the battlefield as he musters his power. This leaves him vulnerable, opening his defiance bar. If players do not break him, he will spawn rot cages under the feet of every player in the raid, as well as extra ones, choking the battlefield. Breaking him will interrupt the attack.

75288.Name: Enfeebling Miasma
75288.Description: Reeg exhales lingering clouds of poisonous gas that travel outward to form 3 roughly conical areas. The gas clouds stay in place for several seconds, poisoning foes inside them.

75289.Name: Rain of Spores
75289.Description: Greer targets 3 players, preferring the farthest away, and then fires a torrent of exploding spores along a line that moves towards the initial position of the target. The spores explode on impact, inflicting damage, poison, and confusion.

75291.Name: Fulgent Fence
75291.Description: Decima periodically links two conduits together with a tether of arcane flux. Enemies entering the beam are damaged and pushed out. Enemies that are shoved into the beam by Decima's attacks are ejected at high speed.

75294.Name: Blob of Blight
75294.Description: If one of Greer's blobs of blight hits a targeted player, it explodes and places a stationary blob of blight that will continue to fire projectiles for several seconds.

75318.Name: Mainshock
75318.Description: Decima slams an orb of arcane flux into the ground, causing a cascade of ruptures to form around her. The ground heaves with enough force to shatter bones and cripple her enemies.

$values.Description: Damage and condition damage taken are increased; stacks intensity.

75330.Name: Scattering Sporeblast
75330.Description: Greer rapidly fires spores in a cone in front of him. Players in this cone will be directly targeted by the spores.

75332.Name: Ripples of Rot
75332.Description: The Greerling leaps into the air towards a targeted player. When the Greerling lands, targets directly under it will be knocked back. It then fires cascades of rot walls that ripple outward, inflicting damage, knockback, and bleeding on anyone they hit. The final rot wall stays in place, blocking player projectiles that hit them.

75343.Name: Seeds of Decay
75343.Description: The shattered fragments of Greer's armor rain down on the arena. Smaller pieces explode on impact, but larger fragments transform into titanspawn, ready to help Greer in the fight.

75346.Name: Seismic Crash
75346.Description:
Decima slams down, causing the immediate vicinity to erupt with jagged rocks and pyrite. The tremendous force sends enemies sliding away. Dodge rolling will end the slide prematurely. Deals increased damge to close targets.

Enemies that impact a conduit will take extra damage and ricochet in another direction.

75348.Name: Fluxlance Salvo
75348.Description:
Decima fires a salvo of fluxlance beams simultaneously. A conduit struck by a beam gains Charge, but blocks the beam's path, allowing targets to take cover if needed.

Makes enemies vulnerable to dancing sparks.

$values.Description:
Recent damage from Decima's fluxlance attacks has made you more vulnerable to dancing sparks.

When taking damage from a dancing spark, you will also take significant extra damage from Galvanic Sensitivity.

Galvanic Sensitivity removes Harmonic Sensitivity and prevents it from being applied for the duration.

75391.Name: Deploy Jade Sphere
75391.Description: Summon your jade sphere, creating a combo field and granting boons to allies in its radius based on its element.
